resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Gauge advisory text folds into context bound

title: Restate slice goal, next command and elapsed time in gauge advisories
body:
Outcome: context-gauge advisories restate the slice goal, the next command and the done condition, and add an elapsed-time line, because Opus 4.7+ (incl. Opus 5.5) gets no built-in remaining-context signal and task budgets are unsupported in Claude Code, so the gauge is the lead's only budget signal. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/papers.md (platform.claude.com context-windows, task-budgets). After t-drwmtf8.
Proof: gauge test asserts the advisory contains goal, next command, done condition and elapsed time read from the capsule.
